blocks.x: Input cost per hectare down 14% — precision agronomy at cooperative scale
A European agri-cooperative (4,200 farms) — Agriculture & Food Systems engagement delivered by a 16-person team over 14 months, EU scope, commercial model: outcome-linked.

items: Field sensing patchy; variable-rate practice guesswork.
Yield/quality discovered at intake; advisory capacity constrained.
Harvest logistics by phone; windows missed.

blocks.x: The field sensor network (soil/weather/crop with governance) feeds agronomy models per plot; advisory assistants extend each agronomist to 3x farm coverage; harvest orchestration schedules machines and crews against weather windows; and the agronomy platform unified machine, lab and advisory data per plot.

Delivery ran on the Achala Method: the Value Mapping Sprint locked the baseline, the gated PoC generated capital-grade evidence, and production hardening (replay, SLOs, control tests) emerged from the work itself rather than a post-hoc audit rebuild.

items: Current programs land down 28 here; the gate reviews the live number, not a projection
The delta we sign up to is down 63 — verified against live data at every gate

blocks.x: Towers: IoT, Digital Twin & Robotics, Applied AI & Generative AI, Agentic AI & Hyperautomation. Platforms: BI & Analytics Platform, Fleet Management System, KYC Management System.

items: Scoped to the seams that actually move the metric, with an owner named on both sides of the interface
Delivered as part of the first working slice, with evidence generated in-flight from day one of the program

blocks.x: Withheld identity, audited numbers: metrics are stated as deltas against the signed baseline, with measurement method and gate evidence available on a reference call.
The fastest start is the same diagnostic this client ran: two weeks, your baseline signed, the delivery pattern priced from evidence.
